name: LCAmendment
description: Represents a formal amendment to an issued Letter of Credit. Each amendment is subject to beneficiary acceptance (UCP 600 Article 10 — amendment is not operative until accepted by beneficiary). Amendments that change beneficiary details or goods trigger a new compliance screening cycle via EVT-076. Owned by SVC-006.

fields.name: amendment_number
fields.description: Sequential amendment number (1, 2, 3...). Used in SWIFT MT707 field 26E.

fields.name: amendment_type
fields.type: array of enum (amount_increase | amount_decrease | expiry_extension | expiry_reduction | latest_shipment_extension | document_change | beneficiary_change | terms_change)
fields.description: Classification of amendment type(s). Multiple types may apply to one amendment.

fields.name: status
fields.type: enum (draft | compliance_screening | issued | accepted | rejected | pending_acceptance)

fields.name: amended_fields
fields.type: object (key-value map of LC fields being amended, with old_value and new_value)
fields.description: Audit-grade record of exactly which LC fields are being changed.

fields.name: compliance_rescreening_required
fields.description: True if amendment changes beneficiary name/country, goods description, or HS codes — triggers new EVT-076.

fields.name: swift_mt707_reference
fields.description: SWIFT MT707 message reference as transmitted to advising bank.

fields.name: issued_date
fields.description: Date amendment was transmitted to advising bank.

fields.name: beneficiary_acceptance_date
fields.description: Date beneficiary formally accepted the amendment. Null = pending or rejected.

design_decisions: Under UCP 600 Article 10(b), an amendment is irrevocable once issued but does NOT take effect until the beneficiary accepts it. The pending_acceptance status models this intermediate state.
amended_fields stores the full before/after delta as a JSON object — this provides audit evidence and enables rollback logic if an amendment is rejected by the beneficiary.
